svg.title: Debrief features
svg.desc: Every process on one timeline: A lane per process and machine, with crashes, errors and starts marked. Patterns with trends: Thousands of lines become a short list, each with its own sparkline. What the errors have in common: Values over-represented among errors, by lift. Compare two windows: See which fields changed before and after the incident.
svg.text: From a pile of files to the one line that matters.
